text: Document-editor Refactor Plan (2/3) — Packages, Services, RabbitMQ

text.text:
*ed.domain* — pure types: `Entity`, `AuditableEntity`, `ValueObject`, `Room`, `Document`, newtypes `UserId`/`RoomId`/`DocumentId`, `DomainError`. No broker/db deps.
*ed.contracts* — `EventMessage<T>` envelope, `Topics::*` catalog (partials per bounded context), event-payload records. Zero deps beyond `serde`.
*ed.errors* — `AppError` → RFC-7807 ProblemDetails, `DomainError`, `InfraError`, `BrokerError`.
*ed.observability* — `init_tracing(service)`, OTLP+stdout exporters, request-id correlation.
*ed.auth* — RS256 JWT verifier via JWKS, `CurrentUser`, `Role`, `Scope`, claims extractors.
*ed.cache* — `deadpool-redis` wrapper; `Cache`, `RateLimiter` (token-bucket), `Session`.
*ed.persistence-postgres* — `sqlx::PgPool` wrapper, `OutboxStore`, `OutboxMessage` row + SQLx migration, `RowStamp` columns.
*ed.persistence-mongo* — `mongodb` driver wrapper, conventions (`_id`, audit fields).
*ed.messaging-rabbitmq* — `lapin` wrapper, `IEventBus`, `Publisher`, `Consumer`, `TypeObjectResolver` (header-driven), `Topology` declarator from `definitions.json`, `OutboxRelayService`.

Each service is an *axum* (or actix) binary using crates from `packages/`.

*room-service*
• HTTP: `GET /api/rooms/{id}`, `POST /api/rooms`
• WS: `GET /ws/room/{id}` (CRDT whiteboard, moved from `backend/src/handlers/websocket.rs`)
• Subscribe: `room.deleted`, `room.user-joined`, `room.user-left`
• Publish: `room.created`, `room.updated`, `room.deleted`, `room.snapshot.{id}.{seq}`
• Persist: Mongo (free-form snapshots), Postgres (outbox), Redis (caches, pub-channel for WS fanout across replicas)

*doc-service*
• HTTP: `GET /api/documents/{id}`, `POST /api/documents`
• WS: `GET /ws/doc/{id}` — wires in the existing-but-disabled `TextDocument` CRDT
• Subscribe: `document.deleted`, `document.commit-recorded`
• Publish: `document.created`, `document.updated`, `document.commit.recorded`, `document.deleted`
• Persist: Postgres (documents), Redis (read cache, pub-channel)

*latex-service*
• HTTP: `POST /api/latex/compile` (calls `pdflatex`), `POST /api/latex/to-docx`
• Subscribe: `latex.compile-requested` (async API over RabbitMQ)
• Publish: `latex.compile.succeeded`, `latex.compile.failed`, `latex.docx.generated`, `latex.docx.failed`
• Store: artefacts on disk volume, metadata in Mongo, outbox in Postgres
• `texlive-latex-base` baked into its Dockerfile

```
Exchanges
  ed.events      (topic,  durable)   — main events
  ed.events.dlx  (topic,  durable)   — dead-letter

Queues + bindings
  ed.room-service     ← ed.events  room.*
  ed.doc-service      ← ed.events  document.*
  ed.latex-service    ← ed.events  latex.*
  ed.audit            ← ed.events  #.audit.recorded
  ed.realtime-gateway ← ed.events  *  (auto-delete)

Routing-key convention: <bounded-context>.<aggregate>.<event>
Envelope: EventMessage<T> = { Id, OccurredAt, ServiceName,
                              Topic, CorrelationId,
                              SchemaVersion, Data }
```
